title: Smiling Toddler Girl in White Dress Outdoors, c. 1960 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot capturing a smiling toddler girl dressed in a white smocked dress as she walks along a sunny concrete sidewalk. Tall garden foliage frames the scene, with another child partially visible sitting nearby on the pavement with toys. The suburban background captures post-WWII American family life in the mid-20th century.
